Necessary platform operation

Shopify may use storage and technical information to operate the site, protect it from abuse and remember privacy choices. Actual platform activity must be included in the final website inventory.

Optional integrations

No new Velani advertising or analytics integration is included in this draft. Optional integrations added later must respect applicable consent and opt-out requirements. A choice to allow a category does not add an integration to this preview.

Make or change a choice

Cookie choices opens the available controls. On Shopify, those controls use its supported Customer Privacy API when available. Consent is recorded from your choice, not automatically. The local review version keeps a demonstration choice only for this tab.

When controls are unavailable

If the platform privacy service cannot be reached, this draft does not start optional integrations as a fallback. Existing Shopify processing is described separately; the absence of newly added code does not prove that the platform uses no cookies.

Browser signals and withdrawal

Applicable opt-out signals and provider behavior must be verified in the final configuration. Changing a choice affects supported processing going forward and does not itself erase data already processed. Contact support@thevelani.com with a privacy question.

Help & questions

Before we start.

Answers about our products, custom development and getting in touch.

Can I sign up for NEVORA now?

NEVORA is in development. Ask about NEVORA to discuss the product; this website does not create a product account.

Does Velani build custom software?

Yes. Describe the application, internal workflow or integration you need through Discuss a project.

Can you give me a price or delivery date here?

A project needs an agreed scope. Fees, milestones and delivery expectations are set out in the engagement agreement.

Does an inquiry start a contract?

No. An inquiry starts a conversation. It does not purchase a product or begin paid work.

Where should I send sensitive information?

Do not send passwords, API keys, payment details or sensitive records through a public form or ordinary email. Ask for an appropriate channel first.

Is this website accepting inquiries?

This is an unpublished website preview. Its form lets you check a draft inquiry without sending it. The public contact email is support@thevelani.com; do not send sensitive records.
